questions.title: Highest Nuclear Share of Electricity
questions.current_disclaimer: Share of net in-state generation from nuclear power reactors.

questions.title: Most Total Electricity Generated
questions.current_disclaimer: Total net electricity generation from all fuels (utility-scale + small-scale) measured in terawatt-hours (TWh).

questions.title: Most Superfund NPL Sites
questions.current_disclaimer: Counts current and proposed final NPL sites; excludes deleted sites and federal facilities may be listed separately by some tallies.

questions.title: Most Wind Turbines
questions.current_disclaimer: Counts operating utility-scale (>=100 kW) turbines only; excludes small distributed and residential turbines.

questions.title: Most Electric Vehicle Registrations
questions.current_disclaimer: Counts light-duty battery-electric vehicles registered in the state; excludes plug-in hybrids in some tallies.

questions.title: Highest Egg Production
questions.current_disclaimer: Total table + hatching eggs from layers; measured in millions of eggs annually.

questions.title: Highest Milk Production
questions.current_disclaimer: Total cow's milk production; measured in pounds annually.

questions.title: Highest Broiler Chicken Production
questions.current_disclaimer: Broilers are meat chickens; measured in pounds of live weight produced annually.

questions.title: Highest Turkey Production
questions.current_disclaimer: Number of turkeys raised annually.

questions.title: Highest Honey Production
questions.current_disclaimer: Honey production from colonies with 5 or more hives; measured in pounds.

questions.title: Highest Maple Syrup Production
questions.current_disclaimer: Finished maple syrup, standard density; measured in gallons.

questions.title: Most Toll Road Mileage
questions.current_disclaimer: Miles of public toll roads (mainline toll facilities). Excludes toll bridges and tunnels reported separately.

questions.title: Most Traffic Fatalities (Total)
questions.current_disclaimer: Absolute counts, not adjusted for population or vehicle miles traveled.

questions.title: Highest Traffic Fatality Rate per 100M VMT
questions.current_disclaimer: Deaths per 100 million VMT normalizes for how much driving each state actually does.

questions.title: Longest Average Commute Time
questions.current_disclaimer: Mean travel time to work (minutes), one-way, workers age 16+.

questions.title: Highest Bike-to-Work Share
questions.current_disclaimer: Share of workers age 16+ whose primary means of commuting is bicycle.

questions.title: Highest Walk-to-Work Share
questions.current_disclaimer: Share of workers age 16+ whose primary commute mode is walking.

questions.title: Most Registered Motor Vehicles
questions.current_disclaimer: All registered motor vehicles, including personal, commercial, and government fleets.

questions.title: Most EV Charging Station Locations
questions.current_disclaimer: Distinct public charging station locations (any level, any port count). Private/residential chargers excluded.

questions.title: Most Registered General Aviation Aircraft
questions.current_disclaimer: Civil aircraft registered to owners with in-state addresses. Excludes commercial airline fleets registered at corporate HQ addresses.
